headline: Yoga and Pilates studio at 140 Worcester-Providence Turnpike approved with conditions; Burbank Road lot variance continued.
summary: Neighbors on Marble Road said cars cut through the back of the building and drive too fast on their street. The studio's approval includes a condition that business access be from 146, not Marble Road. For Burbank Road, members questioned whether they could grant a variance for a lot that does not exist yet.
decisions: Continued the Burbank Road frontage variance to December 3 at 7:00 p.m., 5-0.
Approved the special permit for the yoga and Pilates studio with conditions, 5-0.
discussion: Burbank Road lot variance: Members said they were unsure whether they could grant a variance for a lot that has not been created yet. They suggested getting legal advice and talking with the planning board before deciding.

Marble Road traffic: Neighbors said customers drive through the back of the building onto Marble Road and speed past homes. Members discussed gates, barriers, signs, and speed limits, and the new owner said he would talk with tenants and the town.
Studio hours and conditions: Members set the studio's hours at 5:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., Monday through Saturday. Members said any future sign must follow the town's sign bylaw.

decision_evidence.quote: I'll make a motion to continue to December 3rd at 7:00 p.m. And I'll second that motion. All right, we have a motion and a second. All those in favor of continuing. Mateer, aye. Petrelli, aye. ... All right. The ayes have it.

I'll make a motion to approve permit for the operation of a yoga/Pilates studio with conditions With conditions. ... All those in favor of granting as requested? Matera, aye. Petrelli, aye. Rick Deschenes, aye. Kyle Bergeson, aye. Langendorf, for aye. The ayes have it.

decision_titles: Frontage variance for a new lot at 10 Burbank Road
